header: A long list of references that does not take the whole page
lead: The track is a scroll-snap row, so it works before any script runs: drag it, flick it, or tab into it and use the arrow keys. The next card is left peeking past the edge, because that is the only honest signal that the band continues.

quotes.quote_text: Two to sixteen quotes. The two buttons are the affordance a mouse has no other way to reach, and they grey out at either end rather than lying about what they will do.
quotes.author: The first card
quotes.role: Cards are figures, like everywhere else

quotes.quote_text: Below 768px the arrows are removed: at that width they sit on top of the first and last card, and a touch screen already has the better control.
quotes.author: The second card
quotes.role: The arrows are not the mechanism

quotes.quote_text: This is the only element in the trust group with a script hook, and the hook adds nothing the browser was not already doing.
quotes.author: The third card
quotes.role: Behaviour lives in the shared runtime

quotes.quote_text: The attribution is pushed to the bottom of every card, so two names beside each other sit on one line however long the quotes above them run.
quotes.author: The fourth card
